config.name: d4_motion_thresholds
config.description: Motion-aware calibrated veto on top of the frozen D2 agent, compared with the frozen agent and the D3 global calibrated veto.
config.research_question: Can motion-aware operating points reduce false alarms without significantly sacrificing failure detection?
config.selection_split: validation (S11, S12) only; test (S13-S15) is evaluated once after selection
config.motion_feature: std of accelerometer magnitude per 8-s window, in g (src.experiments.robustness.motion_intensity)

motion_levels.edges: tertiles (1/3, 2/3) of pooled validation motion intensity; test windows are assigned with the same edges

candidates.frozen_agent: D2 Learned Fitted Q decisions, unchanged
candidates.global_veto: frozen agent flag kept only if p_cal >= tau; tau grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.01 (same as D3)
candidates.motion_aware_veto: frozen agent flag kept only if p_cal >= tau[level]; each tau[level] chosen from {0.00} U 0.05..0.95 step 0.01 (0.00 = no veto in that level)

selection_rule.constraint: validation recall >= frozen agent validation recall - 0.05

success_criteria.C1_validation_gain: selected motion-aware veto has validation FPR at least 0.01 (1 percentage point) lower than the selected global veto
success_criteria.C2_out_of_participant: leave-one-participant-out inside validation: select both vetoes (and motion edges) on one validation participant, evaluate on the other; in BOTH folds the motion-aware veto must have lower held-out FPR than the global veto while keeping held-out recall >= held-out frozen-agent recall - 0.05
success_criteria.decision: motion-aware operating points are supported only if C1 and C2 both hold
success_criteria.C3_test_confirmation: reported once, not used for selection: motion-aware test FPR lower than global-veto test FPR, and test recall >= frozen-agent test recall - 0.05

config.reporting_reward: original InvestigationRewardConfig (TP +2, FP -1.5, FN -2, TN 0, cost 0.1 per check)

notes: Frozen D2 agent decisions are read, never modified.
Test participants are evaluated once, after selection on validation.
